mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in the federal funds rate compresses equity discount rates, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as monetary policy eases.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive when FEDFUNDS declines (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Federal funds rate exceeding 4.5% for two consecutive months signals restrictive monetary policy, increasing equity discount rates and causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are not negative in >60% of triggered instances or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in unemployment rate and increases in housing starts indicate labor market strength and consumer demand, predicting positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are not significantly positive when both conditions hold (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansions, housing starts above 550.0 (thousands) signal robust consumer demand, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days as policy tightening looms.
failure_condition: HOUST > 550.0 fails to predict positive 60-day returns in late-cycle expansions (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month upward trend in non-farm payrolls strengthens labor market conditions, predicting positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are not significantly positive when PAYEMS trends upward (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate falling below 5.0% for two consecutive months signals labor market tightness, boosting consumer spending and corporate profits, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not positive in >60% of triggered instances or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in industrial production and housing starts indicate robust manufacturing and construction activity, predicting positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are not significantly positive when both conditions hold (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In monetary tightening cycles, CPIAUCSL growth exceeding 3.0% per annum signals persistent inflation, prompting rate hikes that depress equity valuations, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: CPIAUCSL growth > 3.0% fails to predict negative 60-day returns in tightening cycles (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
